The number of positive divisors of $2026^{20}$ can be calculated using the formula $(a+1)^n$, where $a$ is the exponent of the prime factor and $n$ is the exponent of the prime factor. In this case, $a = 20$ and $n = 20$, so the number of positive divisors is $(20+1)^{20} = 21^{20}$.
